in_sanskrit.name: देवमन्विथ
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who embodies multiple forms of God, like a god among gods (Deva manvith).

in_hindi.name: देवमन्विथ
in_hindi.long_meaning: देवों (Devas) में एक देव (One god among gods)

in_tamil.name: தேவம்ந்வித்
in_tamil.long_meaning: அவர் தேவம் (He is the god) among gods (manvitham)

in_telugu.name: దేశమన్విథ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: దేశము దేశములో (He is the god) among gods (manvith)

in_marathi.name: Devmanvith
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devmanvith हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devmanvith is a Sanskrit name composed of 'Deva' (god) and 'manvith' (wisdom or intellect). The name symbolizes the divine will and the wisdom bestowed upon an individual by the gods.
